terra.problem: Saying the end is much farther down the road than the feast adds a timeline the verse does not give.
The meal was underway when the devil had already put betrayal into Judas' heart. The verse does not say this happened before the meal began.
The passage does not say whether Pilate has entered the room. 'Yet' also suggests he will enter it later.
The passage does not say Herod is absent from the supper. The card also does not identify which King Herod it means.
Twelve pairs of feet adds a number the passage does not give.
Jesus says Peter will understand later, but He does not say that Peter's lack of understanding is okay for now.
The mustache-twitch joke has no clear matching action: Peter refuses the washing, but the text does not describe him twitching.
Peter refuses to have his feet washed, not the promise that he will understand later. 'Peter doesn't take the offer' and 'Not later. Never' blur that distinction.
Saying Peter doesn't do things halfway makes a general claim about him that this passage does not establish.
Jesus washes their feet before He speaks about being Teacher and Lord, not afterward.
The quotation describes someone who shares His bread; it does not say the person sits at His table.
The quotation does not say the person is at the table with Him.
